title: RAW_UNREVIEWED: paired chey constructions at f76r.42 and f83r.3
summary: GDT1055 fixes daiin chey lchedy across f76r.42/f83r.3. The first complete line also has dain chey lsh immediately before it; the second has chkeedy chey immediately before it. Test a repeated relation or comparison template against a serial list or process reading, retaining daiin as axis-open and requiring one independent whole-line or image binding before a meaning decision. GDT982 tests another chey line and does not select a global connector.

design.mechanism: A local chey relation joins two complete neighboring constituents in a parallel pair; lchedy is the repeated right-hand constituent, with no global word gloss assumed.
design.unit: The two complete GDT1055 source lines f76r.42 and f83r.3, then exact eligible parallel templates on released nonreserve leaves.
design.contrast: Locally paired relational construction versus serial field list or temporal process; use whole-line dependencies and independently owned image features, not recurrence itself, to choose.
design.prediction: A relational reading must assign compatible operand roles to both chey positions in f76r.42 and to the nested chey environment in f83r.3; a fixed temporal-step reading fails if an independently bound same-line role forces simultaneous alternatives. If no external role binding exists, record MISSING_BINDING rather than semantic PASS.
design.scope: Raw exploratory proposal; f84/f84r and reserves excluded. GDT1055 RESULT.json and GDT791 line-owner atlas are the primary source records.
